code:
Change a service account through:
  SQL Server Configuration Manager

Why: it also grants "log on as a service"
and fixes registry/file permissions —
services.msc alone leaves those unset.

Result of skipping it: service won't start.
caption: Configuration Manager applies the permissions a plain account swap misses.
